category_edits.rationale: Apply the supplied coupled hypothesis across all four categories: increase embedding dropout to 0.15 and reduce Adam learning rate to 7e-4 to moderate updates under stronger regularization. This configuration previously regressed in the supplied evidence; no improvement is assumed. Preserve architecture, loss, readout, training limits and one checkpoint per category. Existing metadata and predictor loading remain compatible.

change_summary: Jointly set shared dropout to 0.15 and Adam learning rate to 7e-4 for the four independent GRU4Rec category models.
